item.title: Gov. Ferguson amends WA emergency declaration
item.description: Governor Bob Ferguson has announced he will amend the state's emergency declaration, and that his office has identified millions of dollars to fast track to flooded communities.

item.title: Wind storm knocks out power to thousands in Seattle, western WA
item.description: A wind storm knocked out power to thousands of people across the Puget Sound Tuesday, with more outages expected into the evening and overnight.

item.title: LIVE UPDATES: Washington flooding, road closures, evacuations
item.description: FOX 13 is tracking the latest weather conditions across western Washington as the region remains under a Flood Watch with heavy rainfall and strong winds expected to continue.

item.title: 80-year-old woman thrown in ditch by hit-and-run driver in Port Orchard, WA
item.description: An 80-year-old woman was walking near her home when the Kitsap County Sheriff's Office says a man hit her and turned around to drive the opposite direction.

item.title: Man arrested after punching Seattle bus driver
item.description: Police arrested a man for punching a Sound Transit bus driver in downtown Seattle late Monday night.

item.title: Seahawks Notebook: Playoff scenarios, Charles Cross still DNP
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks need only a win or tie this week, or a loss or tie from the Detroit Lions against the Pittsburgh Steelers to secure their spot in the playoffs.

item.title: Blizzard Warning for WA passes, Wind Warnings, and flooding continues
item.description: Heavy rain is pushing Western Washington rivers toward major flood stages, and warnings are in effect for strong winds and an overnight blizzard at the passes.

item.title: NBA to make decision on possible expansion in 2026 with Seattle, Las Vegas top candidates
item.description: The NBA plans to make a decision regarding domestic expansion in the coming year, Commissioner Adam Silver said Tuesday, confirming Seattle and Las Vegas are the top candidates.

item.title: Some Pacific, WA residents return home after evacuating from White River flooding
item.description: Areas of the city of Pacific were still blocked after neighborhoods were flooded due to a levee breach Tuesday morning.

item.title: Seattle Kraken squander third period lead, lose 5-3 to Avalanche
item.description: Nathan MacKinnon scored twice for an NHL-leading 28 goals this season and added an assist as the Colorado Avalanche beat the Seattle Kraken 5-3 on Tuesday night for their third straight win.
